OFF_semantics: Not used in this campaign; historical raw reference only.
ON_semantics: Frozen V2.2 make_accounting(True), comparison current>=absolute deadline. Deadline supplied by campaign parameter adapter.
interpretation: 마감시간 만족률 TIR_admission includes ALL admitted frames, including expired failures. Raw-vs-timely gap not assumed.
stop: Control/integrity failure stops subsequent workload. User restores CPU before standalone analyzer.
allowed_scope: Preparation only; separate approval for exactly eight Local-only 208-FPS runs. No retry/resume/overwrite.

overlap_rule.interval: [t_pre_infer,t_infer_return), active-admitted executed Local frames including drain
overlap_rule.other_worker: union of OTHER worker host infer intervals
overlap_rule.full_overlap: overlap_ns == duration_ns (exact full coverage, no epsilon)
overlap_rule.limitations: Host overlap is not GPU kernel overlap; matching overlap does not isolate resource contention

timely_rule.invalid: INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID; invalid/missing repeat is not a service failure
timely_rule.thresholds: Prespecified engineering target/margin; not physical laws
timely_rule.backlog: Preserve legacy B=admitted-completed; U=admitted-completed-expired is actual unfinished work
timely_rule.budget: executed active-admitted cohort incl drain; D-(service_start-source_arrival); expired has no service start
timely_rule.thermal: No start-temperature cutoff;10s fixed minimum idle after drain+cleanup; no result-dependent changes
timely_rule.analysis_restore_gate: CPU_RESTORE_READBACK statusPASS,mode restored, exact saved controls/topology, timestamp after child exits

energy_status: Thor VIN active source verified; full-run energy coverage review required
